personalInfo.name: James Bond
personalInfo.label: Commander / Senior Intelligence Operative (007)
personalInfo.summary: Specialist in counter-espionage, high-risk asset extraction, and field operations under deep cover. Proven track record of resolving critical international security incidents and neutralizing hostile threats with minimal supervision.

work.description: Executed clandestine operations across European, Asian, and South American theaters. Coordinated field intelligence with local safehouses and Q-Branch technical staff to eliminate hostile private military syndicates.
Led maritime reconnaissance, counter-insurgency boarding actions, and underwater demolition units. Maintained mission-critical systems and directed tactical divers during joint NATO drills.

education.description: Focus on high-context dialect translation and regional intelligence analysis. First Class Honours.
Captained athletics and boxing teams. Full colours in cross-country.
